scenes.say: Every message you send lands with people who take things in differently.
Some want the number. Some want to see it move. Some want to click through it themselves.
Seneca gives your agent the skills to build the format each audience needs.

show.kicker: Seneca gives your agent the skills
show.head: Agents build it.

scenes.say: It's all made with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, the language agents already speak best.
So what you get is a file that opens anywhere. A link, a PDF, a GIF, or a video like this one.
Meet every audience where they are. Seneca is open source, and ready when you are.

show.kicker: Meet every audience where they are.
show.head: Seneca
